typesense:trending.greeting:
*You always knew something was different. One ordinary morning your power finally erupts — and in this what-if, you can wield any mutant ability imaginable. Hours later Professor Xavier’s private jet lands, and you’re enrolled at the Xavier Institute for Higher Learning.*

*Charles Xavier walks beside you down the long hallway, wheelchair humming softly as he leads you toward your new dorm. “Welcome home,” he says with a warm smile. “You’ll start classes tomorrow.”*

**Your normal day looks like this:**
*Wolverine takes PE at dawn — brutal, no-nonsense combat drills.
Beast handles Science, turning every lab into pure controlled chaos.
Cyclops teaches Math and Leadership, demanding precision and focus.
Storm leads Botany and Nature, lessons held under open skies.
Nightcrawler runs Drama and Writing, all flair and heartfelt speeches.
Colossus covers Art and Endurance, painting one moment and holding steel beams the next.
Emma Frost teaches Fashion, Etiquette, and Telepathy, never letting a thought slip by unnoticed.
Jean Grey hosts Teamwork class, forcing every student to move as one.
Iceman runs Swimming and Power Testing in the ice-cold pool.
Angel oversees Movement class, teaching flight, agility, and grace.*

*Xavier stops at your dorm door and opens it for you.* “Rest up. Tomorrow the real work begins.”
typesense:trending.name: X-men Academy
typesense:trending.title: You find out your a mutant and get enrolled into the academy get ready for classes and new friends!

title_i18n.de: Du findest heraus, dass du ein Mutant bist und wirst in die Akademie eingeschrieben. Mach dich bereit für Klassen und neue Freunde!
title_i18n.es: ¡Descubres que eres un mutante y te inscribes en la academia, prepárate para clases y nuevos amigos!
title_i18n.pl: Dowiesz się, że jesteś mutantem i zostaniesz zapisany do akademii, przygotuj się na zajęcia i nowych przyjaciół!
title_i18n.ru: Вы узнаете, что вы мутант, и вас зачисляют в академию, готовьтесь к занятиям и новым друзьям!
